== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-commchief-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Comm Chief]]: The game text changes: “any starship” becomes “anything”; “. When piloting a starship or combat vehicle” is removed; “and” is added after “combat vehicle,”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•••Comm Chief” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
